messages:
Alicia H.: Hey team — drafting the customer follow-up for the Dedicated EU incident. Putting the proposed message below; please review for accuracy and tone before we send to the affected accounts.

Alicia H.: PROPOSED CUSTOMER NOTE:
Hi <Customer name>,

We’re writing to follow up on the service disruption you experienced on Mar 9 UTC. Summary: between 09:12 and 09:48 UTC, requests served from our eu-west Dedicated pool saw elevated error rates (502/503) and increased per-token latency for some model variants. Root cause: a bad quantization rollout that introduced incompatibilities in the runtime kernel selection for certain model/device combinations.

What we did: we rolled back the quantization profile at 09:24 UTC, which restored normal error rates by 09:40 UTC. Full rollback completed and verification finished by 09:48 UTC.

Impact: ~4% of requests from your Dedicated instances experienced failed responses or >2x latency during the window. We’ve identified the affected model variants and verified no persisted data exposure.

Customer-facing mitigations and credits: we propose a one-time invoice credit equivalent to 4% of March Dedicated usage for impacted instances, and a free month of enhanced observability (48h longer retention for per-route traces).

Preventative actions: a) strict canary gating for quantization changes with faster automated rollback on kernel mismatch, b) expanded CI test matrix to include quantized runtime kernels against representative hardware profiles, c) additional runtime telemetry to detect kernel selection anomalies earlier.

Next steps: we can schedule a 30-min technical walk-through with your engineering team this week if helpful.

Please review and suggest edits.

Mateo (on-call): Thanks — timeline looks correct. Small nits: rollback started at 09:24, but the automated fallback kicked in at 09:28 for a subset; error rates trended down at 09:36 and were back to baseline by 09:40 on most nodes. We should call out the fallback window and that some nodes required manual restart.

Priya R.: Confirming root cause summary. Add: the quantization config pushed a kernel flag that caused a mis-match for kernels compiled with AVX2-only builds on that particular VM image. We're adding a gating job in CI that runs the kernel selection matrix against our runtime artifacts.

Dan C.: On the credits: recommending we offer the 4% usage credit OR a $X credit option for non-metered enterprise accounts. Also we should provide the customer with a short checklist of mitigations we took (rollback, node restarts, kernel compatibility checks).

Alicia H.: Good catch, Mateo & Priya. I'll update timeline lines. Dan — noted on credit options; I'll add both sentence variants so AM can pick.

ops-scribe: incident-bot posted: "INCIDENT 2026-03-09 EU-WEST: quantization rollout -> elevated 5xxs. Sev2. Mitigated: rollback + manual restarts. Postmortem in progress." :white_check_mark:

Mateo (on-call): Suggest we include a brief reassurance about keys/data: "No customer keys, data, or embeddings were exposed. The failure impacted inference serving only." That reduces anxious follow-ups.

Priya R.: Also add an explicit remediation ETA: CI gating rollout planned for next sprint (ETA 2 weeks). Runtime kernel compatibility tests: 1 week to add; rollout of gated quantization profile after testing: 2 weeks.

Alicia H.: Updated draft with the added timeline & reassurance. New proposed credit language: "We are offering a one-time usage credit equal to 4% of impacted Dedicated March usage; for enterprise accounts we can provide an equivalent account credit — please let us know your preference."

Dan C.: Approve from CS side. Recommend we push a short FAQ entry for the customers: "Will this happen again? How will you prevent it?" — two bullet answers.

Alicia H.: I'll add a 2-bullet FAQ. Final ask: can Eng/SRE approve sending by EOD so AMs can notify customers tomorrow morning?

Mateo (on-call): Approved from SRE with the clarifications above.

Priya R.: Approved. I'll follow up with a short technical appendix we can attach for customers who want more details.

incident-bot: Deploy log: rollback applied 09:24 UTC; partial automated fallback at 09:28 UTC; manual restarts completed by 09:35 UTC; verification checks green 09:48 UTC.

Alicia H.: Thanks — sending final version to AMs now. I'll post the finalized message here once it's outbound. :thumbsup:
